# TSLA (Tesla, Inc. · NMS) — Trading Analysis
**Analysis date: 2026-10-22** | Data window reviewed: 2025-10-22 → 2026-10-22 (252 sessions)

---

## 1. Indicator selection & why these eight

| Category | Chosen | Why it's complementary *in this specific regime* |
|---|---|---|
| Moving averages | `close_10_ema`, `close_50_sma`, `close_200_sma` | TSLA is currently caught between *opposing* trend authorities — a rising medium-term average and a falling long-term average. Trading it without all three horizons would be guessing. |
| Momentum | `macd` (+ signal/histogram from the verified snapshot) | The 10-day price swing has been violent; MACD's rate-of-change deceleration is the cleanest early warning that the October bounce is losing thrust. |
| Momentum | `rsi` | Price is making marginal new recovery highs; RSI tells us whether momentum confirmed them. It did not (see §4). |
| Volatility | `boll_ub`, `boll_lb` | The last 6 weeks have been a range. The bands define the tradable envelope and are currently *re-expanding* after a mid-September squeeze. |
| Volatility | `atr` | Two-sided overnight gap risk in this name has been extreme (see §7). ATR is required for any stop-loss or position-size claim. |

Deliberately excluded: `macds`/`macdh` (redundant with `macd`, but the verified snapshot supplied them for cross-checking), `boll` middle (it is the 20 SMA underlying the two bands I already hold), and `vwma` (dropped to keep the set at eight with balanced trend/momentum/volatility coverage; volume was read directly from the price file instead).

---

## 2. Verified data integrity

`get_verified_market_snapshot` for 2026-10-22 matches `get_stock_data` and each `get_indicators` call exactly — **no discrepancies found**:

- OHLCV: **Open 374.03 / High 388.86 / Low 373.71 / Close 374.58 / Volume 51,339,690**
- `close_10_ema` 372.73 · `close_50_sma` 363.12 · `close_200_sma` 386.64 · `rsi` 52.80 · `macd` 2.86 (signal 2.80, hist +0.06) · `boll` 369.86 · `boll_ub` 390.77 · `boll_lb` 348.95 · `atr` 12.62

*(Caveat: the 2026-10-22 bar is the terminal row of the vendor file; it should be treated as the current/latest session and re-confirmed at the next open.)*

---

## 3. Trend structure: three horizons, three different answers

This is the single most important thing to understand about TSLA today — **the horizons disagree, and they disagree in a very specific, tradeable way.**

**Long-term (200 SMA) = bearish and still falling.** The 200 SMA sits at **386.64** and is declining (393.18 on 2026-10-02 → 386.64 on 2026-10-22, roughly −0.47/session over the last two weeks; 400.57 on 2026-08-31 → 386.64 now). Price at 374.58 is **3.12% below** it. On a one-year view the damage is clear: peak close 489.88 (2025-12-16, with a window-high intraday 498.83 on 2025-12-22) vs. trough close 298.32 (2026-07-29, intraday low 297.38) — a −39.1% peak-to-trough decline on closes. Year-over-year, 438.97 (2025-10-22) → 374.58 (2026-10-22) = **−14.7%**.

**Medium-term (50 SMA) = constructive and rising fast.** 363.12, up from 346.57 on 2026-10-01. Price is **+3.16% above** it, and every October pullback has been bought ahead of it.

**Short-term (10 EMA) = neutral, knife-edge.** 372.73, with the close at 374.58 — only **+0.50%** above the fastest average. The 2026-10-22 session chewed the entire October cushion in one day: the 10 EMA was 368.16 on 2026-10-19 versus 372.73 today, so price has been forced to outrun it and has now snapped back onto it.

**The critical structural insight:** the 50/200 spread has compressed from **47.3 points on 2026-09-30** (346.96 vs. 394.23) to **23.5 points today** (363.12 vs. 386.64) — roughly half the gap in three weeks, with a rising 50 SMA chasing a falling 200 SMA. Because the oldest rows now rolling out of the 200-day window are the December-2025 prints (~475–490), the 200 SMA should keep grinding *down* over the next 6–8 weeks even if price goes nowhere. **The overhead ceiling is descending to meet the price.** Traders who only look at the daily chart will treat 386 as a fixed wall; it is a melting one.

---

## 4. Momentum: the bounce is running out of thrust

**MACD — inflection point, in real time.** `macd` fell from **5.14 (2026-10-12)** to **1.27 (2026-10-19)** — a 75% collapse in the value during the 354–362 pullback — then rebounded to 2.85 on 2026-10-21 and effectively **stopped dead at 2.855 today versus 2.853 yesterday**. Signal line is at 2.80, so the histogram is **+0.06: statistically zero.** A MACD line that re-accelerates upward after such a flush is a bullish continuation tell; one that posts a second, weaker hump and flattens exactly under the prior peak (5.14) is a momentum failure. This is the latter. Note MACD remains *positive* — so this is not yet a fresh downtrend signal, it is a **stall**.

**RSI — a clean, measurable bearish divergence at the range top.** Price made a sequence of higher recovery highs (380.12 close on 2026-09-23 → 382.70 on 2026-10-09 → 386.47 on 2026-10-21), but RSI made a flat-to-lower sequence (**60.59 → 59.73 → 59.77**). Today it closes at **52.80**, down 6.96 points in one session. RSI is neither overbought nor oversold — the 70/30 framework is useless here — which is precisely the point: **there is no momentum edge in either direction at 374.58.** The tradable momentum signal was the divergence at 386–389, and it has now fired.

---

## 5. Volatility & Bollinger envelope: mid-September squeeze → expansion → top-tag

- **Envelope today:** lower 348.95 / middle 369.86 / upper 390.77 → width **41.83 points (~11.3%)**. Close sits at **%B = 0.61**, i.e. the upper-middle of the band, *not* pressed against the top.
- **Squeeze → break:** band width compressed to roughly **33.9 on 2026-09-16** (374.86 − 340.92) and **34.8 on 2026-09-21**, then expanded through October (**35.55 on 2026-10-02 → 41.43 on 2026-10-16 → 41.83 today**). That squeeze resolved **upward** (354.81 on 2026-09-30 → 386.47 on 2026-10-21, **+8.9%**).
- **Where the bands are pointing:** the upper band is now flattening (391.05 on 2026-10-16 → 390.77 today) while the lower band has also stabilised (348.68 on 2026-10-12 → 348.95 today). **Both boundaries are horizontal = the market has stopped pricing an expanding trend.** Combined with the failed top-tag (§6), the most probable next outcome is the band width contracting again and price reverting toward the 369.86 middle rather than trending out of the range.
- **ATR:** **12.62 (3.37% of price)** and *rising* — 11.04 (2026-10-13) → 11.85 (2026-10-16) → 12.62 (2026-10-22), after fading from the 15.31 spike on 2026-09-08. Two wide-range sessions re-inflated volatility. This is the third consecutive signal saying "the trend is not resolving cleanly": MACD flat, bands flat, ATR up.

---

## 6. Anatomy of the last five sessions — a textbook high-volume bull trap

| Date | Open | High | Low | Close | Volume | Read |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| 2026-10-16 | 369.15 | 370.50 | **349.33** | 354.72 | **62.07M** | Flush into the lower band (349.62) — sold out, *held* |
| 2026-10-19 | 357.50 | 369.58 | 354.47 | 368.06 | 38.82M | Sharp reclaim, close +3.76%, back over 10 EMA |
| 2026-10-20 | 370.28 | 377.59 | 363.64 | 373.71 | 32.12M | Consolidation, shrinking tape |
| 2026-10-21 | 381.43 | **388.84** | 380.51 | **386.47** | 48.88M | Breakout attempt: poked *above* 200 SMA (386.94) intraday, closed marginally **below** it |
| 2026-10-22 | 374.03 | 388.86 | 373.71 | **374.58** | **51.34M** | **Gap down ~3.2%, new intraday high by 0.02, then reversal −3.08% on heavy volume; close 1.12 off the low** |

Three things in this tape are unambiguous:

1. **The 386–389 ceiling has now rejected price four times in five weeks**, all supported by concrete rows: 2026-09-25 (high 386.83, close 372.11), 2026-10-09 (high 388.56, close 382.70 → faded to 354.72 within five sessions), 2026-10-21 (high 388.84, close 386.47), 2026-10-22 (high 388.86, close 374.58). **Never once did TSLA *close* above the 200 SMA on the way up.**
2. **Volume told the truth.** The two heaviest sessions in this stretch were 2026-10-16 (the flush, 62.07M) and 2026-10-22 (the reversal, 51.34M) — both against the buyers. The *up* leg (38.82M, 32.12M) was fed by 10–40% less volume than the distribution days. Meanwhile 2026-10-12 (20.24M) and 2026-10-13 (18.39M) were the **two lightest prints in the entire 252-session window** — that is textbook late-stage range contraction before the fake breakout.
3. **Today's bar is a wide-range reversal at resistance**: 15.15-point range, close near the low, above-average volume, immediately after a divergence-flagged high. As a single candle, it is the most bearish-shaped bar since the 2026-10-16 flush — and it arrived exactly at the ceiling.

**The counter-argument, stated honestly:** the same tape shows *demand* at the bottom of the range. 2026-10-16 tagged 349.33 against a lower band of 349.62 and reversed +6.2% to 374.58 by 2026-10-21 (+7.0% over the four sessions). This is currently a two-sided range with functioning floors *and* functioning ceilings, not a downtrend.

---

## 7. Risk management (ATR-anchored)

- **ATR = 12.62 ⇒ ±12.6 points is one standard "expected" day.** A stop inside 1 ATR from entry in TSLA will be hit by noise. Use **1.5×ATR ≈ 18.9 pts** and **2×ATR ≈ 25.2 pts** as the working stop distances.
- **Gap risk is the dominant tail.** Two examples from this file: 2026-07-23 — prior close 374.01, open 341.00 (−8.8% gap), close 319.69 (**−14.53%** on 115.6M shares); and the upside twin, 2026-04-15 — 364.20 → 391.95 (**+7.6%** on 113.8M shares). **A 15% single-session move is a demonstrated, not theoretical, outcome in this name.** Size for it or don't hold through event dates.
- **Sizing:** relative to a 1.5×ATR stop, position risk per unit of capital should be materially *smaller* than for a broad-market instrument; volatility has just re-accelerated (ATR +14% in six sessions) while bands have stopped expanding — an unstable combination.

---

## 8. Actionable framework

### Primary read: a fading bounce at a descending ceiling, inside a functioning range — **reduce/take long exposure, do not chase, do not short into the floor.**

**For longs (structural thesis, needs confirmation):**
- **Do not add at 374.58.** Everything that argues for the bounce (50 SMA rising, price above it, mid-Sept squeeze resolved up, 349 support held) is already priced; nothing new is being paid for here.
- **Preferred entry zone: 362–366** — a retest of the rising 50 SMA (363.12, climbing ~1/day) with the 10 EMA (372.73) as the near trigger. Stop below 348 (under the lower band 348.95 and the 2026-10-16 low 349.33) ≈ 2×ATR from the zone.
- **Legitimate breakout entry, the disciplined version: a daily *close* above ~391** (above the upper band 390.77 *and* the 2026-10-16 high-water 391.05), ideally on >55M volume. Waiting for the close costs the first 4% and avoids precisely the trap that fired today.
- Targets if 391 clears: **405–410** (May-2026 congestion), then **433–445** (2026-05-11/13 closes 445.00/445.27).

**For shorts/tactical hedges:**
- The asymmetry is best on a **retest of 383–388** (the four-touch ceiling plus the declining 200 SMA at 386.64), with RSI back above ~58 and MACD histogram ≤0 as the confirmation pair. Stop above 393; first target **369.86** (Bollinger middle), then **363** (50 SMA).
- **Do not short below ~355.** The 345–355 shelf is where the highest volume in the range was absorbed (349.33 low on 2026-10-16, 345.88 low on 2026-09-30, 349.62 lower band). Short interest into that shelf is how the +6.2% four-session squeeze happened.

**For the uncommitted — a genuine "no-trade" zone:**
- **363 ≤ price ≤ 386** with RSI 45–62, MACD flat at zero, and horizontal bands is a range with no edge. Today's close at 374.58 sits *in the middle of the no-trade zone*, ~1.3% above the Bollinger middle. The honest call for a discretionary trader today is to **wait for the boundary**, not to invent a signal at the centre. ATR rising into a non-expanding band is what churn costs money.

**Invalidation checklist — what would change this report:**
1. **Bullish invalidation:** a close above **391**, *plus* MACD histogram turning decisively positive above +0.5 and RSI >65. That breaks the 50/200 ceiling convergence and opens 405–445.
2. **Bearish invalidation of the range floor:** a close below **348.95** (lower band) *and* below the 349.33 swing low on expanding ATR. That flips the structure back to the 2026-07 regime, targeting **330 → 313/306** (2026-07-24 close 313.03, low 306.51; 2026-07-29 low 297.38).
3. **Trend-authority flip:** a **daily close above the 200 SMA**, which has not happened on this bounce. Until it does, rallies should be treated as countertrend within a defined long-term downtrend, regardless of how strong the 50 SMA looks.

---

| Momentum (RSI) | **Bearish divergence** | Price 380.12→382.70→386.47 vs RSI 60.59→59.73→59.77; now 52.80 | Divergence already fired at the ceiling |
| Volatility (ATR) | **Re-accelerating** | 11.04 (10-13) → 12.62 (10-22), 3.37% of price | Stops at 1.5×ATR (≈18.9) / 2×ATR (≈25.2) |
| Bollinger | **Squeeze resolved up, now flattening & top-tagged** | Width 33.9 (09-16) → 41.8 (today); UB 391.05→390.77 flat; %B 0.61 | Mean-reversion toward 369.86 is the base case |
| Volume | **Distribution on top, absorption on bottom** | 51.34M on the 10-22 reversal & 62.07M on the 10-16 flush vs 18.39M/20.24M on 10-13/10-12 (lightest in 252 sessions) | Fades at 386–390, bids near 349–355 |
| Structure | **50/200 convergence: 47.3 pts → 23.5 pts in 3 weeks** | 2026-09-30 vs 2026-10-22 | The 200 SMA ceiling is melting downward — patience beats a chase |
| **Overall stance** | **Defend/take longs; no edge at mid-range; fade 383–388; do not short <355** | Close 374.58 | Range regime: trade the boundaries or wait |

**Bottom line for TSLA:** the 2026-10-22 tape is a high-volume failed breakout at a four-touch, declining 200-day ceiling, confirmed by a stalled MACD histogram and a fresh RSI divergence — but it is *not* a new downtrend, because the rising 50 SMA at 363.12 and the absorbed 349–355 floor are both intact. The expected path is mean reversion toward 369.86 and a test of 363, with the range only genuinely resolving on a close above 391 or below 348.95.

# TSLA Sentiment Report: 2026-10-15 to 2026-10-22

## Executive summary

Sentiment on **TSLA** over the past seven days is **Mixed with a near-term bearish skew**. The clearest divergence is between **immediate retail tape pressure** and **longer-term narrative enthusiasm**. StockTwits is strongly bearish in the last 24 hours, with posts pointing to an after-hours fade, capex-cut disappointment, valuation concerns, and speculation about $300. At the same time, Reddit and X show a meaningfully bullish or speculative tilt around Tesla’s Q3 results, autonomous/robotics product hype, analyst target raises, and the SpaceX/Tesla merger theme. The news flow reinforces this split: Tesla-specific positives include earnings/FCF beats, Semi production, Optimus progress, and bullish analyst revisions, while the broader backdrop is negative on tech/AI risk appetite, higher oil, market volatility, and governance/key-man distraction around Elon Musk.

**Overall read:** the market is not uniformly bearish on the TSLA thesis; it is more accurately a **high-engagement, high-volatility, story-driven stock undergoing a near-term sentiment reset**. The bullish narrative remains present but is crowded by macro risk, Musk-related distractions, merger uncertainty, and retail frustration over price action.

---

## 1. News headlines — institutional framing

The Yahoo Finance / news feed over the period is a mixture of company-specific positives, strategic-optionality speculation, and macro-driven negativity.

### Key themes

- **Q3 results were better than feared, but the market faded the reaction.** StockTwits references Tesla “sold more EVs than it built for a second straight quarter,” free cash flow beating, and the quarter itself being “fine,” while the Street sold the reported **$20B capex cut** and pushed shares lower. This suggests the earnings event is not read as fundamentally weak, but the guidance/portfolio-shift narrative may have disappointed growth expectations.

- **Capex and AI spending plans cut to $20B are ambiguous.** “Tesla cuts 2026 capex to $20B amid tech transformation plans” and “Tesla Stocks Edge Higher Although AI Spending Plan Shrinks” imply cost discipline and balance-sheet support, but in a market already worried about AI capital intensity, lower spending can also be interpreted as growth restraint or delayed transformation. The stock initially “edge[d] higher,” but other coverage later ties Tesla to a broader tech selloff and “fail[ing] to meet expectations.”

- **SpaceX / Tesla merger chatter is the dominant strategic narrative.** Multiple headlines cover Musk’s desire to merge SpaceX and Tesla and SpaceX’s clarification that a merger would require Musk’s approval. This creates both **optionality** and **governance uncertainty**: TSLA holders may see access to SpaceX upside, while others see dilution, key-man risk, and corporate-control complications. Reddit and X chatter around SPCX and TSLA reinforces this as a major attention driver.

- **Product/innovation narrative remains loud.** Headlines and related social posts reference the Roadster, Optimus production at Fremont, the Semi entering volume production, and Cybercab long-term forecasts. The bullish case is heavily tied to autonomous vehicles, robotics, and Musk’s product-stage storytelling.

- **Macro and volatility risk are negative.** Coverage of the Nasdaq/S&P 500 selling off on “revived AI doubts,” crude oil above $110, Iran-related geopolitical risk, and “Tesla Volatility Exposes Hidden Risk Across 553 Funds” weighs on sentiment. TSLA is not discussed in isolation; it is treated as a high-beta, crowded volatility asset within a risk-off tech tape.

**Net news sentiment:** **Mixed to slightly negative.** The news supports the idea of improving fundamentals and product momentum, but it also highlights valuation fragility, macro headwinds, and uncertainty around capex, merger approval, and market reaction.

---

## 2. StockTwits — fast-moving retail sentiment

StockTwits is the most clearly bearish source for the immediate TSLA tape.

### Quantitative read

The screened StockTwits block shows **21 on-topic TSLA messages** out of 30 fetched. There is a slight discrepancy between the visible label count and the classifier summary:

- User-labeled sentiment: **Bullish: 2 / 10%**, **Bearish: 8 / 38%**, **Unlabeled: 11**.
- Screened stance classification: **1 bullish, 9 bearish, 3 neutral, 8 unclear**.

Even with the discrepancy, the direction is consistent: **bearish messages outnumber bullish messages by roughly 4:1 to 8:1**, depending on classification method. For a 21-message sample, this is not overwhelming proof of broad retail capitulation, but the tone is strongly negative enough to be treated as a meaningful near-term signal.

### Bearish evidence

Several posts point to a post-earnings fade and technical weakness:

- **@TheeInsidersEdge** reports TSLA closed **$374.58 (−3.1%)**, notes the quarter itself was “fine,” and says the Street sold the **$20B capex cut**. This is a critical narrative: price weakness is attributed to guidance/spending reaction, not necessarily to headline earnings failure.
- **@ABMteam** complains that Tesla sold off in after-hours after initially gaining, indicating retail frustration with an unhelpful post-earnings tape.
- **@ElGordoGekko** repeatedly mentions puts, a potential close below **$363/$362**, a double-top concern, and downside toward **$300**.
- **@Baazigar123** simply asks “$300?”, signaling bearish psychological anchoring.
- **@Marcusmccord** references options positioning and alleged market-maker activity around the **370 put**, reinforcing a tactical downside setup.
- **@ChazBoner** cites a fatal pedestrian incident involving a self-driving Tesla, adding regulatory/autonomy perception risk.
- **@trumpdisasterprez** calls TSLA “150 x sales” and warns against Musk dilution, making valuation and merger/governance fear explicit.
- **@illianamike** and **@NaughtyNeighbor** post strongly negative Musk-related commentary, reflecting key-man and political-reputational drag.

### Bullish evidence

The bullish tone is present but sparse and mostly technical:

- **@Beachside_BagHolder** argues TSLA was near **$395**, was dragged down by the broader market, and claims a “face ripper is incoming.”
- **@Windflying72** expresses bullish Musk-related sentiment, though the post is more personal/ideological than analytical.
- **@Sub_Zero0** sees a near-term decision range that could resolve to **$390** or **$350**, capturing volatility but not directional conviction.
- **@Sainteur** highlights free cash flow beating estimates, a positive fundamental data point even if unlabeled.

**Net StockTwits sentiment:** **Bearish near-term**, with a strong focus on price action, options positioning, after-hours weakness, capex disappointment, valuation, and Musk-related governance risk.

---

## 3. Reddit — community discussion and speculative positioning

Reddit provides the opposite tilt from StockTwits. The screened summary shows **9 of 10 posts fetched were about TSLA**, with a stance classification of **5 bullish, 0 bearish, 3 neutral, 1 unclear**. However, the substance is thin and heavily speculative.

### Bullish/speculative evidence

- **r/wallstreetbets posts** dominate the bullish count. “Whole portfolio on 14x TSLA 387.5c 10/23,” “20k Roth yolo on Tesla,” and “GAIN: TSLA and MU plays of the week” show options-driven bullish speculation, especially around earnings/expiry.
- The **Rivian** post references a prior TSLA options gain, suggesting traders still remember the stock’s explosive optionality but are rotating into another EV name.
- **r/stocks** includes “Tesla beats on earnings and sales even as auto revenue declines,” with the stock rising slightly in extended trading. This is the most balanced positive fundamental signal from Reddit.
- The SpaceX post “SpaceX (SPCX) Up 8% In Premarket. Real Buy or Trap?” is neutral-to-bullish context and reinforces the merger/strategic-overlap narrative.

### Limitations

- Reddit has no vote or comment counts, so the posts cannot be weighted by community support.
- The bullish posts are mostly options gambling or short-duration speculation, not necessarily durable fundamental conviction.
- **r/investing** returned no TSLA posts after screening, meaning there is no visible longer-term fundamental investing discussion from that subreddit in this dataset.

**Net Reddit sentiment:** **Bullish or speculative, but low substance.** It supports the idea that some retail participants are leaning into upside optionality, while StockTwits shows other participants reacting bearishly to the actual tape.

---

## 4. X / Twitter — high-engagement narrative and attention signal

The X sample is noisy but useful as an attention and narrative tracker. The source fetched **85 posts** over the window, with a model-selected subset shown; it is therefore not a census, and should be weighted by engagement and credibility.

### Bullish / high-engagement product hype

Several high-engagement posts emphasize Tesla’s product and technology story:

- **@WatcherGuru** reports Musk saying the new TSLA Roadster “will be sentient,” with **8,257 likes**, making it the single largest engagement signal in the sample.
- **@StockSavvyShay** highlights a “flying car” TSLA unveiling with **2,561 likes**.
- **@TheProfInvestor** frames the “Flying & Backflip car” as historic Musk spectacle with **542 likes**.
- **@herbertong** and **@StockSavvyShay** report Optimus robots coming off Fremont lines with management describing the process as “suitable for a commercial product,” a concrete manufacturing/robotics signal.
- **@StockMKTNewz** reports the Tesla Semi is now in volume production, adding to the product-execution narrative.
- **@herbertong** reports Wall Street moving targets higher after Q3, including a **Piper Sandler $475** target and **CLSA upgrading from Underperform to Hold** with a **$400** target, with the stock “back up near $388.”
- **@ChrisDungeon** says TSLA received **7 price-target raises and zero cuts**, listing multiple bank targets above $400. This is a strong institutional-optimism signal, though it appears via X rather than the provided news feed.
- **@StockMKTNewz** reports Cathie Wood / Ark’s 2031 base case of **$4,400 per share**, an extreme long-duration bullish scenario.

### Skeptical / negative X evidence

- **@TeslaXplored** says hundreds of thousands believed the Roadster event was fake, with **2,020 likes**, indicating skepticism and reputation risk around product hype.
- **@BradMunchen** posts are the most negative on Musk himself, with one at **3,486 likes** arguing his involvement in Washington politics is a problem for TSLA/SPCX and another at **779 likes** escalating political controversy.
- **@KinggTrades** repeatedly warns new investors that TSLA will not simply pump off events, and jokes that the Roadster price may be $500k rather than $250k.
- **@daltonbrewer** asks “WHY IS $TSLA PUMPING?” in a way that can be read as surprised bullishness or skeptical short-covering commentary.
- **@ElGordoGekko** appears on StockTwits with bearish merger/dilution questions, while X includes merger curiosity and “real buy or trap” framing.

**Net X sentiment:** **Mixed but attention-bullish.** The highest-engagement posts skew toward product spectacle, target raises, and long-term bull cases. The negative posts are concentrated around Musk’s political behavior, credibility of demos, valuation, and merger/dilution concerns.

---

## 5. Cross-source divergences and alignments

### Major divergence: StockTwits vs Reddit / X

The clearest cross-source split is:

- **StockTwits:** strongly bearish near-term, focused on $374.58 close, −3.1%, after-hours selling, capex cut, $300 downside, and puts.
- **Reddit:** mostly bullish/speculative, focused on calls, earnings beat, SpaceX premarket upside, and optionality.
- **X:** largely product/analyst bullish in high-engagement posts, with skepticism centered on Musk and merger governance.

This divergence suggests a market in transition: the **headline earnings and product narrative are bullish**, but the **actual trading reaction is bearish**. That combination is often more actionable than a one-directional sentiment collapse because it may indicate a crowded long trying to find conviction while the tape is rejecting the event.
